sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Shopify Development Company Kochi

items.q: How is Shopify different from WooCommerce?
items.a: Shopify is a fully hosted platform — Shopify manages servers, security, and updates for you, at a monthly cost. WooCommerce runs on WordPress and gives you full ownership of code and hosting. Shopify suits businesses that want a managed platform with less technical overhead.

items.q: Can you migrate our existing store to Shopify?
items.a: Yes — our Shopify migration services handle moving products, customer data, and order history from other platforms with minimal downtime.

items.q: Will our Shopify store be optimised for search engines?
items.a: Yes. Shopify SEO optimization is built into setup — page structure, collection organisation, and metadata are configured with search visibility in mind from the start, though Shopify's platform has some built-in SEO limitations we'll walk you through.

items.q: How long does Shopify store development take?
items.a: A typical store, depending on catalogue size and custom features, takes 3–5 weeks from requirements review to launch. Larger catalogues or custom app requirements can extend this timeline.

items.q: Do you build custom Shopify apps?
items.a: Yes. When an existing app doesn't cover a specific need, our Shopify app development Kochi work builds custom functionality directly into your store.

items.q: Can you customize product pages to match our brand?
items.a: Yes — Shopify product page design is tailored to your brand and product type rather than left as a default theme layout.
